== Combo placement on the original version ==
The Bow To The First Order combo was duplicated on the Original article, whose printed text does not grant the extra [Episode VII] icons. Removed that misplaced duplicate; the claim remains on [[The First Order Was Just The Beginning (Errata 2)]], which grants the location icons. The [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thefirstorderwasjustthebeginning.png published Errata 2 image] and [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Players Committee card data] support that placement.
